rules.says: __PRESENT__ is selected without its twin __ABSENT__: the two cover one rule by different means; select both.
__PRESENT__ judge the same commands from one shared table: keep one, or a command is judged twice.
__PRESENT__ refuses every new dependency until __FILE__ exists (not found in the current directory); create it first.
__PRESENT__ refuses every MCP server until __FILE__ exists (not found in the current directory); create it first.
__PRESENT__ warns only, being measured (observe): nothing is refused.
__PRESENT__ is text only: nothing stops a violation (advisory).
__PRESENT__ is also in the chock plugin __PLUGIN__ (__PATH__): both copies fire; remove it from one of the two selections.
Codex skips a plugin's hooks until you review and trust them in /hooks, and asks again after a hook changes: until then every policy here is advisory.
Devin runs plugin hooks best-effort and fails open: a hook that errors or times out lets the action through.
This client names no file-write tool a hook can match, so a gate judges what a turn wrote only at turn end; the write itself is not held.
On Cursor Teams and Enterprise an admin setting (Allow Local Plugin Imports) can turn local plugins off, and an installed marketplace plugin of the same name takes precedence over this one.
Untested: chock has not witnessed an install in this client. Its steps, its hooks and the plugin version string (<bundle.version>+<digest12>) are unmeasured there.
